purpose: Use actual retained baseline evidence to investigate and correct the scoped Go defect through the complete delivery process.

execution.instructions: Read the full scoped Go execution receipt; missing selected tests, incomplete execution and skipped proof are not acceptance. On an initial join rejection, use review feedback and manifest to repair the concrete conflict. Evidence may be baseline/join evidence before the first combined check; it never establishes current-candidate acceptance. Read the accepted plan/card manifest and full current check/measurement evidence before repairing the combined candidate. Preserve completed cards and original acceptance; do not replan. Follow the request, AGENTS.md and docs/testing.md; keep acceptance fixed. Read the supplied baseline and measurement artifacts, including structured evidence; missing sidecars and truncated stdout are incomplete proof. Use all correction feedback. Configured steps own checks and measurements: do not run them. Hand off runnable source when measurement is needed without claiming resolution. Preserve identities, difficulty/uniqueness, saves, public validation, bounds and unrelated work. Missing capability, a material decision or no supported safe fix within limits returns blocked with precise evidence. Never change workflow, permissions or budgets. Return a summary of at most 240 characters; do not claim pending checks passed. For benchmark collectors, RUNNER_MEASURE_EVIDENCE is an existing directory: write named .json files using filepath.Join(dir, name), at most 64 files and 8MiB total. Copy helper-provided RUNNER_MEASURE_ROUND, RUNNER_MEASURE_SOURCE_IDENTITY, RUNNER_MEASURE_SOURCE_SHA256 and RUNNER_MEASURE_SOURCE_DIGEST_METHOD into evidence; never invent source/round metadata or require unstated variables. Keep combined console output below 256KiB with compact summaries; never log full JSON with b.Log. Read measurement_history as a runner-measure-history-v1 bundle, parsing entries programmatically by sequence/source and decoding their exact measurement JSON; do not dump the bundle. Before its first append this input may be the explicitly incomplete pristine baseline; the separate measurement input retains the actual current complete or failed report. Preserve first-before and original controls; choose matched instrumentation/runtime/seed evidence, not round alone.
